import sys
import time
import json
import random
import numpy as np

def load_instance(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return np.array(data["A"], dtype=int), np.array(data["B"], dtype=int)

def compute_cost(p, A, B):
    return float(np.sum(A * B[p][:, None] * B[p][None, :]))

def local_search(A, B, time_limit):
    n = A.shape[0]
    # Initial permutation: identity (or random)
    p = list(range(n))
    random.shuffle(p)
    current_cost = compute_cost(p, A, B)
    best_cost = current_cost
    best_perm = p[:]

    start = time.time()
    # Main loop
    while time.time() - start < time_limit:
        # ---- Neighborhood search (2‑swap) ----
        improved = True
        while improved and time.time() - start < time_limit:
            improved = False
            # Random order of pairs to try
            indices = list(range(n))
            random.shuffle(indices)
            for i in range(n):
                if time.time() - start >= time_limit:
                    break
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    if time.time() - start >= time_limit:
                        break
                    # Perform swap
                    p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
                    new_cost = compute_cost(p, A, B)
                    if new_cost < current_cost:
                        current_cost = new_cost
                        if current_cost < best_cost:
                            best_cost = current_cost
                            best_perm = p[:]
                        improved = True
                    else:
                        # Revert
                        p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
        # ---- Random restart if time permits ----
        # If we have consumed most of the budget, stop restarting
        elapsed = time.time() - start
        remaining = time_limit - elapsed
        if remaining > 0 and random.random() < 0.15:  # occasional restart
            p = list(range(n))
            random.shuffle(p)
            current_cost = compute_cost(p, A, B)
